messages.subject: Final Pitch Deck Submission & Demo Day Logistics
messages.body:
Hello JARVIS Team,

We are excited to confirm that your project "JARVIS — The Time Traveller" has been shortlisted for the final evaluation round in the Autonomous Agents track.

Key Requirements:
1. Please ensure your demo endpoint is publicly accessible and running live.
2. Submit your final architecture diagram and slide deck by 11:59 PM tonight.
3. You will have a 5-minute uninterrupted live demonstration slot followed by 3 minutes of technical Q&A with judges.

Please reply with your confirmation and public live URL.

Best regards,
Track Committee

threads.subject: Urgent: Review NIST Agentic Safety and Model Citation Audit
threads.snippet: Regarding compliance for autonomous model dispatch and tool execution gates...

messages.subject: Urgent: Review NIST Agentic Safety and Model Citation Audit
messages.body:
Hi Team,

I reviewed your latest multi-step orchestration pipeline. I am particularly impressed by the explicit human-in-the-loop security gates implemented before external side effects like email dispatch and database writes.

Could you confirm whether all external communications retain an immutable audit log with cryptographic or timestamped tokens? This is required for our NIST AI RMF audit compliance.

Thanks,
Dr. Elena Rostova
Principal Safety Auditor
messages.snippet: Could you confirm whether all external communications retain an immutable audit log...

messages.body:
Hi,

I have attached the dataset summary table for ingestion into JARVIS knowledge database.

Warm regards,
Aravind
